description: Specify the label for trace s . This is the label that will appear when plotting the trace.
notes: Trace auto-naming differs across versions: ball trace creates trace '1' on 6.00/7.00 but trace '0' on 9.8, so a trace name '1' lookup fails there with 'ParticleTrace not found'.
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-10 on the six PFC consoles (2D/3D x 6.00/7.00/9.8) (syntax grade): trace name <s> label <s> accepted on all six (on 9.8 against the '0' auto-name); label is the only keyword offered after the name in the live enumeration.
